arguments.summary: Decision framework: develop differentiated 21/63-session research theses for ANET, QQQ, MU, META and NVDA against the declared SPY and sector benchmarks, without rankings, allocation guidance or calibrated forecasts. Four neutral grouped research requests are pending: company fundamentals/valuation, macro/rates, technicals, and geopolitics. Commodities is not separately assigned because no direct commodity-price transmission or source has yet been established; semiconductor supply-chain policy is within company/geopolitics scope.

claims.text: The decision framework requires reconciliation of issuer fundamentals, QQQ holdings look-through, macro/rates, price behavior and geopolitical-policy transmission; no one channel is assumed decisive before the pending research is received.

gaps.description: Specialist evidence for issuer fundamentals, ETF holdings look-through, macro, technicals and geopolitical channels has not yet completed, so no instrument assessment is supportable at planning.

assumptions: The research horizon is 21 and 63 sessions.
SPY and the stated XLK/XLC comparisons are contextual benchmarks, not allocation recommendations.
Any company valuation sensitivity will state its EPS and P/E inputs as scenarios rather than consensus or calibrated forecasts.
arguments.counter_thesis: Broad market/rates moves or policy news could dominate issuer-specific catalysts over the stated horizons, limiting the usefulness of company-specific scenarios alone.

review_conditions.description: Review integrated evidence after the accepted company, macro, technical and geopolitics tasks complete, including whether a common dependency overrides issuer-specific evidence.
